name: Zabbix Problems
author: ldechnik
description: Unresolved Zabbix problems in the Omarchy bar, summarized by highest active severity.

barWidget.description: Shows the highest unresolved severity and opens a filterable problem list.

schema.label: Zabbix URL
schema.description: HTTPS frontend URL or full api_jsonrpc.php URL.

schema.label: API token file
schema.description: File containing the API token on its first non-empty line. Use mode 0600.

schema.label: Custom CA certificate
schema.description: Optional CA certificate for private or self-signed Zabbix deployments.

schema.label: Disable TLS verification
schema.description: Unsafe fallback. Prefer a custom CA certificate.

schema.label: Problem limit
schema.description: The panel warns when more matching problems exist.

schema.label: Acknowledgement
schema.description: Narrow the panel list and the bar count to problems in this acknowledgement state.

schema.label: Only acknowledged by me
schema.description: Applies only while Acknowledgement is Acknowledged. Needs user.checkAuthentication permitted for the API token's role.
